card.name: Right before the word sodium
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name, or a percent sign or unit, when the next word is "sodium" (e.g. thiopental sodium, 0.9% sodium chloride, 50 mg sodium).

modes.label: Salt drug names
modes.description: End of a drug name that is followed by "sodium" as its salt form.

modes.label: Saline strength
modes.description: The percent sign in 0.9% before "Sodium Chloride" in diluent lists.

modes.label: Amount of sodium
modes.description: A unit or "of" after a number, right before "sodium" as an amount.
modes.example: 256 mg, and 440 mg<< of>> sodium per 2.25 g

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "Na" or "sodium"-like tokens next.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is expected to be "sodium", such as in sodium salts or saline.
